sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: Cuenca is a central Spain sport climbing area about two hours from Madrid.

sections.heading: History and context
warnings: No sourced history and context content found for this pass.

sections.heading: Rock and climbing character
sections.body: The climbing is on old limestone, with technical vertical and overhanging routes, crimps, small holds and two-finger pockets.

sections.heading: Who it suits
sections.body: The area is especially relevant for sport climbers who want technical limestone and harder routes, while still having grades across the area.
